definitions.gloss: automatic ticket gate; fare gate (at a station)
definitions.explanation: The automated gate at a train or subway station that passengers pass through by inserting a ticket or touching an IC card. The machine checks the fare and opens or closes the barrier.

examples.japanese: {改札機|かいさつき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦カード→カード：03836_kaado⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かざした→かざす：28115_kazasu⟧。
examples.english: I held my card over the ticket gate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{切符|きっぷ}→切符：00643_kippu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{改札機|かいさつき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I put my ticket into the ticket gate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{残高|ざんだか}→残高：05422_zandaka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}り→足りる：01209_tariru⟧ず、{改札機|かいさつき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ゲート→ゲート：10851_geeto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{閉|し}まって→閉まる：00754_shimaru⟧しまった。
examples.english: My balance was insufficient, and the ticket gate's barrier closed on me.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{改札|かいさつ}→改札：04120_kaisatsu⟧ (ticket checking) + ⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧ (machine). In everyday speech the gate is often called simply ⟦{改札|かいさつ}→改札：04120_kaisatsu⟧, referring to the ticket-gate area as a whole.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {改札機|かいさつき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}る→通る：01243_tooru⟧: to pass through the ticket gate
- {自動|じどう}{改札機|かいさつき}: automatic ticket gate (full term)
- ⟦カード→カード：03836_kaado⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{改札機|かいさつき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦かざす→かざす：28115_kazasu⟧: to tap a card on the gate
